mainEntity.name: Our Old Town building is in a landmark district — how does that affect projects?

acceptedAnswer.text: Exterior work in the Old Town Triangle District generally requires review by the Commission on Chicago Landmarks before permits issue. We build that review into project timelines, prepare the documentation, and match the work to approved materials so projects clear without surprises.

mainEntity.name: Do you take on small or self-managed Old Town associations?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes — converting self-managed buildings is one of the most common ways associations come to Stellar. We set up the books, vendor contracts, and governance calendar in a 30-to-60-day transition, with flat pricing from $20 per unit per month.

mainEntity.name: Does Stellar Property Management serve Old Town?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Stellar Property Management provides condominium, HOA, and townhome association management in Old Town, Chicago (ZIP 60610, 60614), backed by a Chicago office that has served area communities since 2007 — 29 associations and approximately 1,422 residences under management, with a 96% client retention rate since 2007.

mainEntity.name: What types of community associations does Stellar manage in Old Town?

acceptedAnswer.text: Stellar's association-management model is designed for condominiums, townhomes, HOAs in Old Town. Every client community receives a dedicated property manager, transparent monthly financial reporting, 24/7 live emergency response, and board support informed by applicable Illinois association requirements.

mainEntity.name: How much does association management cost in Old Town?

acceptedAnswer.text: Stellar management starts at $20 per unit per month. We quote a customized flat monthly fee based on your Old Town association's size, amenities, staffing, financial complexity, and service scope — never a percentage of your budget. We do not add a separate capital-project planning or management-oversight fee. Third-party professional and contractor costs remain association expenses.

mainEntity.name: How do we switch our Old Town association to Stellar?

acceptedAnswer.text: Switching is a managed 30–60 day transition: once your board signs, we retrieve records from the outgoing firm, migrate banking and vendor relationships, notify owners, and open your board and resident portals. Call 773.728.0652 or request a proposal online to start.

mainEntity.name: How should a Old Town board choose a condo or HOA management company?

acceptedAnswer.text: Compare at least three firms on the same terms: an active Illinois management firm license, a credentialed manager (CMCA, AMS or PCAM), a flat monthly fee in writing, who answers emergencies at night, and how records move during the transition. Stellar Property Management is a licensed Chicago firm (license #291000211) that has managed associations since 2007, publishes its pricing, and answers emergencies with a live person 24/7. Boards in Old Town can score any proposals side by side with Stellar's free comparison tool at stellarpropertygroup.com/tools/compare-management-proposals.
